title: Mystic Math Crystal
description: A glowing crystal ball hovers above a dark chalkboard covered in colorful mathematical equations, formulas, and a radiating rainbow spectrum. A lit candle in a brass holder, scattered papers, a drafting compass, and lavender sprigs surround the board against a textured blue background.
prompt: A glowing crystal ball filled with floating numbered papers and glowing mathematical symbols hovers above a black chalkboard covered in colorful equations like 10sin(x)+y^2-5 and integrals. A lit candle in an ornate brass holder, crumpled papers, a golden drafting compass, and sprigs of lavender rest on the board which emits a radiant rainbow light burst. Dark textured blue background with subtle technical drawings, surreal and mystical atmosphere.
